params.adoption: lift >= 1.5 AND marginal capture >= +3pp on some asset AND per-FIT-year lift sign-stable (>1 every year); P2 also must beat the unconditional split on pinball loss
params.degenerate: a receipt whose SANE session range is $0 (frozen quote; m0 SPEC_DEFECTS D8) is dropped before any target, anchor or prior-session read - the b2/b3 exclusion, unchanged
params.era_law: FIT = FIT_2021_2024 (exploratory census); GATE_2025 echoed separately; 2026 sealed (never opened)
params.mid_sane: D-054/CC-M1-4: TWO_SIDED and spread_$ <= min(10 x trailing-phase-median spread_$, $500); trailing median = same-phase per-session medians over the 20 STRICTLY PRIOR sessions (>= 5 observations, else only the cap binds); insane seconds typed-excluded, never interpolated
params.null: family levels displaced +0.5 x ATR14_prev_$ / mult, sign alternating by level index within the family (D-052 null)
params.p1_calibration: per-side excursion ratio (anchor->extreme)/sigma_hat, trailing 250 sessions strictly prior, >= 30 obs; the ladder machinery of b2_fvol.ladder, one-sided
params.p2_design: [1, sign(overnight ret), |gap|/ATR14, prior up_share, RV5/RV66, DOW dummies Tue..Fri]; expanding-window monthly refit, >= 250 training sessions; coefficients FROZEN at the last FIT-era refit for the 2025 echo (b2 era law)
params.p2_null: unconditional split = trailing median up_share (same walk-forward window)
params.p3: OR = first {30,60} min of each segment from its first SANE second; levels OR_H + k x OR_range / OR_L - k x OR_range, k in {0.5,1.0,1.5,2.0}; target = the rest-of-window extreme
params.p4: floor {PP,R1,S1,R2,S2} and Camarilla {H3,L3,H4,L4} from the prior session's SANE H/L/C
params.p5: overshoot = signed distance from the realized extreme to the NEAREST PRIOR EXTREME IT EXCEEDED (prior-session H/L + prior-phase H/L); distribution fitted on the FIT era per asset (in-sample by spec order); delta in {0,p25,p50,p75}, tick-rounded
params.p6: gap session iff |session open - prev settle| > 0.25 x ATR14_prev; prev settle predicts the extreme OPPOSITE the gap direction
params.p7: score(p) = number of distinct (family, tick-rounded price) levels within tol of p over KEPT ledger families + P1..P6; zones = local maxima of the score (plateau-deduplicated, merged within tol); top-k by score then price; null = zone centres displaced +0.5 x ATR14 alternating by rank
params.targets: session and per-phase HIGH/LOW of the dominant-instrument MID-SANE mids; every predictor strictly causal at its anchor
params.tolerance: max(2 x tick_$, 0.05 x ATR14_prev_$) / mult
